notes.title: Patch 0.4.3
notes.content:
Fixed a few bugs and tweaked some relics.

Fixes
Fixed an issue where only certain enemies to spawn on the first level
Fixed an issue with the 'Wealth Fist' relic to follow the player longer than it should
Made improvements to the Guard's Blocking. This should reduce situations where the player gets hit even though it felt like they should have blocked an attack

Changes
Reduced the base damage of 'Mightning'
Increased the base damage of 'Jar of Souls'

notes.title: Patch 0.4.1
notes.content:
Hotfix patch fixing a couple of issues.

notes.title: Dark Umbra Patch 0.4!
notes.content:
[h2]Highlights[/h2]
[h3]New character added!
The Guard[/h3]

[h3]All characters now have directional special moves!

Each character now has unlockable skins at the Inn! Complete runs as each charcter to unlock them all![/h3]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the name of some relics would get cut off on the pickups
[*] Fixed an issue preventing players from picking up 'Shield of the Betrayed' multiple times
[*] Fixed an issue that caused multiple relics to incorrectly activate upon level up:
[list]
[*] 'Shield of the Betrayed'
[*] 'Belt of the Barbarian'
[*] 'Boots of the Barbarian'
[*] 'Gloves of the Barbarian'
[*] 'Eagle Claw'
[/list][*] Adjusted a room in the Tundra to prevent the level generation getting stuck under rare circumstances
[*] Fixed an issue causing some projectiles to have wrong sprites for a frame after spawning
[*] Fixed a errant pixel appearing in the Ranger's run animation
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Boss Health bar's font has been updated and the position of the name moved
[*] Changed spacing on the Relic pickup prompt to improve readability
[*] Relics now show exactly how their stats change when they level up
[*] Buff Icon size has been increased
[*] 'Crying Ring' Relics now have a buff icon when active
[*] 'Windrider Horn' Relic now has a buff icon when active
[/list]
[h3]Sprites[/h3]
[list]
[*] Some Mercenary sprites have been updated
[*] Some Frog sprites have been updated
[*] Some Guard sprites have been updated
[*] All characters now have separate air and ground sprites for using relics
[/list]
[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] Frog now has a sound effect for firing bubbles
[/list]
[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Price of 'Gold Gained' upgrade has been increased from 200 to 500 per level
[*] Effect of 'Movement Speed' upgrade has been decreased from 5% to 2% per level
[*] Reduced delay between enemy waves from 40s to 30s
[*] Reduced Attack Speed buff of Haste Shrines from x1.35 to x1.15
[/list]
[h3]Relics[/h3]
[list]
[*] 'Bloodletting leech' had its base power increased, as well as its scaling per level
[*] 'Cheese' can now drop multiple cheeses
[*] 'Blue Crying Ring' description has been updated to more accurately match its effect
[*] 'Field Bandages' had its starting strength and scaling lowered
[*] 'Leper's Mask' had its starting strength and scaling adjusted
[*] Adjusted the base power and growth rates of the Fairy relics
[*] 'Pegasus Boots' had its scaling adjusted
[*] 'Vanguard's Shield' and 'Warden's Shield' had their descriptions updated to more accurately match their effects
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for Patch 0.3.2 (March 13th)
notes.content:
We're back with another round of fixes and changes for Dark Umbra. With most of the bugs we're aware of being fixed, the next patch should be our first batch of new content (barring any hotfix patches). As always, if you find any issues, please let us know over in the Community Hub!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Crimson Bracelet's effect no longer incorrectly persists between runs
[*] Fixed an issue when playing on controller where any down input on the thumbstick would drop you through platforms
[*] Alt-Tabbing during level transitions no longer prevents the minimap from clearing
[*] Being revived by the Messiah's Tear now properly counts towards the revival achievement
[*] Fixed an issue allowing players to pause the game during a level transition
[*] Fixed a graphical issue in the bestiary which sometimes caused a black sprite to appear
[*] Trail Blazer relic no longer frame rate dependent
[*] Enemy kill counts in the bestiary no longer reset when a lore tome drops
[*] Animated Weapon enemies can no longer attack while stunned
[*] 'Golden Tooth' charm no longer requires a restart if unlocked in town
[*] 'Present' upgrade no longer causes issues when switching between offline and online
[*] Corrected damage scaling on bosses
[/list]
[h2]Achievements[/h2]
[list]
[*] 'Success From Suffering' no longer re-locks itself
[*] 'Bestial Speed' now correctly tracks
[*] 'Thrive Under Pressure' can no longer be unlocked while dead
[*] 'Diverse Researcher' no longer displays an incorrect description
[/list]

[h2]Online Play[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing the Sewer Boss to desync
[*] Wealth Fist now properly spawns extra treasure for clients
[*] The Gold Goblin moonwalking has been fixed :(
[*] The pause menu now properly closes during level transitions
[*] Fixed an issue where, if a client let the timer run out during relic selection at level up; their next relic selection could potentially get skipped
[*] Fixed an issue causing enemy defence being applied twice to client damage in certain circumstances
[*] Achievement 'Sorcerous Self-Destruction' now properly unlocks for clients
[*] Fixed an issue where quitting an online game with certain relics would cause unknown behaviour
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a door to the final elevator to prevent players from getting stuck
[*] 'In Search of Aid' now requires 10 Healing Shrine uses (Down from 40)
[*] 'Vermin Control' now requires you to slay 200 Ratkin (Down from 300)
[*] Upgrade shop now shows the maximum rank of an upgrade
[*] Updated description of the 'Holy Pauldron' Relic to more accurately match its effect
[*] Updated name and description of the Defence upgrade in the shop to more accurately match its effect
[*] Added a new icon to display a player's Damage Reduction
[*] Trail Blazer's logic has been rewritten to make it hit enemies more reliably and decrease performance impact on low-end hardware
[*] Controller can now flick the stick down quickly to fall through platforms
[*] Red Crying Ring now affects both Physical and Magic damage
[*] Player can now activate Healing Shrines even if they're at full health
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for Patch 0.3.1 (February 6th)
notes.content:
Hope you're all enjoying the game! We've got our first patch notes here for Patch 0.3.1 with a slew of fixes and improvements. Let us know if you run into any issues. More updates to come in the future!

Fixed
[list]
[*] The Achievement "A Small Step to Peace" now displays correct quantity required
[*] Added walls on the Castle level to prevent players from getting stuck out of bounds
[*] The following achievements now track correctly:
[list]
[*] 	Blessings From the Past
[*] 	In Seek of Aid
[*] 	Spirit Feast
[*] 	Relic Enthusiast
[/list][*] Successful Runs now track correctly
[*] Fixed an issue where the background in the Sewer level could be misaligned in certain situations
[*] Game no longer receives input when out of focus
[*] Dualsense Edge controllers should now work properly
[*] Fixed an issue where the player would be locked in place if they were hit on the frame they started a combo attack
[*] Fixed an issue where players couldn't use keyboard or controller input for certain Yes/No inputs
[*] Fixed an issue where failing a run would incorrectly add to the player's Total Revive stat
[*] Fixed an issue where certain charms couldn't be equipped simultaneously
[*] Equipped charm indicator now properly appears on the charm screen
[*] Enemy status icons now display for all players
[*] Fixed an issue causing the effect of the King's Gambit relic to remain permanently between runs
[*] Gold dropped during online play now correctly scales
[*] The Gold Gain upgrade now works properly
[*] Fixed an issue where multiple players could activate the same shrine simultaneously
[*] Fixed certain achievements not tracking when playing in an online game
[*] Stun icon no longer incorrectly displays on bosses
[*] Item Shrines now properly scale with stage count
[*] Castle elevator now properly de-spawns in online games
[/list]

Changes
[list]
[*] Ranger arrow now travels further off screen before de-spawning
[*] Enemy fireballs now disappear after hitting the player
[*] Added a lever to the final elevator
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update Version .02
notes.content:
Hope everyone's enjoying the game!

We've released an update that fixes a few bugs and hopefully improves everyone's experience.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]Major Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*]A bug preventing players from unlocking Ratman or Frogbert on their first time launching the game has been fixed. Unfortunately any player who experienced the bug previously will need to defeat the bosses again if they haven't done so already
[/list]
[h2]Minor Bugs And Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Improved description of the Jar of Souls relic
[*]Players can now press the cancel button to close more menus (default B on controller, Right-click or K on keyboard/mouse)
[*]Slight buff to Belt of the Barbarian so that it works at lower levels
[*]Purchasing an active relic will now immediately pick it up if you have an open slot
[*]Mouse cursor will no longer appear when playing with a controller
[*]Improved Snow level generation and fixed a rare progression blocker
[*]Removed the tall jump jet holes from the sewer as they weren't working as intended
[*]Removed the invisible wall that could sometimes appear in the swamp level
[*]Repositioned a chest that was under the map in the snow level
[*]The game version now appears on the main menu
[*]The stun indicator should no longer incorrectly appears on bosses
[*]Lowered the knockback on static metal, making it less annoying to fight enemies with
[*]Static Metal now correctly scales off of your magic stat
[*]Fixed an issue where certain projectiles would move at different speeds depending on the frame rate
[/list]

Let us know if we've missed anything and happy hunting!
